WITH base AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode, b.tgtcode AS tgtcode, b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    NULLIF(e.ZJLXMainNetTur,-999999) AS `m1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  LEFT JOIN newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_ext e ON e.mktcode=b.mktcode AND e.tgtcode=b.tgtcode AND e.bizdate=b.bizdate
  WHERE b.bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode, tgtcode
FROM base
WHERE (`m1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode, tgtcode;

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    NULLIF(e.ZJLXMainNetTur,-999999) AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  LEFT JOIN newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_ext e ON e.mktcode=b.mktcode AND e.tgtcode=b.tgtcode AND e.bizdate=b.bizdate
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 THEN SUM(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`f1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;
